title: Warm Smoked Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A dense and festive Algerian dish featuring sweet smoked paprika and leaf wrap steam, with a mustardy flavor, perfect for special occasions
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute
Add the lamb shoulder and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes
Add the smoked paprika, dried apricots, chicken broth, mustard, bay leaves, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine
Cover the Dutch oven with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven
Braise the tagine for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender
Remove the bay leaves and serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro
Traditionally, the tagine is cooked in a clay pot with a conical lid, but a Dutch oven is a suitable substitute
